d: Company Description Kuwait Credit Information Network Company (CINET) is a closed Kuwaiti shareholding company that specializes in collecting, preserving, analyzing, and using credit information to prepare credit records and issue credit reports and classifications for individual and corporate clients. The company develops risk tools, standards, and related data in line with Law No. 9 of 2019 governing credit information exchange and its executive regulations. CINET serves the financial, banking, and commercial sectors by providing comprehensive credit reporting, credit rating, and value-added services. The organization is committed to data integrity, regulatory compliance, and supporting stakeholders in making informed credit and risk decisions.

r: Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, administer, and maintain enterprise security solutions, including firewalls, antivirus, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and network security devices to ensure effective protection of IT infrastructure.

Operational Reporting & Continuous Improvement: Prepare security operations reports, analyze recurring issues, evaluate existing controls, and recommend improvements to strengthen security effectiveness and operational efficiency.
